project.purpose: Decompose confirmed website Human/Agent authority and effect-replay responsibilities, with explicit canary scope and cross-Security consumer contracts. No new Web runtime or registry.

nodes.label: WebAuthnPrincipalAndChallenge
nodes.responsibility: Bind one account/Principal to an authenticated WebAuthn credential/challenge lifecycle by delegating protocol verification to SimpleWebAuthn.
nodes.authority: Web product/session/effect state only; Security/provider cryptographic and policy truth remain external
inputs: principal/enrollment context; one-shot challenge and credential records
outputs: authenticated Principal identity and consumed challenge or denial
nodes.behavioralContract: Challenge consumption is one-shot; credential and challenge are persisted to the Owner-local store; browser/virtual authenticator proof is not a claim of physical human presence.
acceptance: Owner session/challenge tests verify one-shot behavior and browser E2E evidence scopes without treating canary enrollment as production-ready.
mustNotOwn: Security Agent OAuth/DPoP verification or Agent admission policy
production IAM enrollment or deployment acceptance
formalObligations: Refinement gap: real external authenticator/canary enrollment/production recovery and installed TLS context remain UNKNOWN.

nodes.label: BrowserSessionAndMutationAdmission
nodes.responsibility: Admit human browser state mutations only under an authenticated opaque session plus CSRF, exact Origin and Fetch-Metadata checks.
nodes.authority: Web product/session/effect state only; Security/provider cryptographic and policy truth remain external
inputs: opaque browser session cookie; server-stored hash, session expiry/revocation state
outputs: Principal session projection; admitted authenticated mutation or typed denial
nodes.behavioralContract: Session token is not an authority-bearing credential beyond its exact server-bound identity; unsafe browser mutations require same-site and CSRF guards; session idle/absolute expiry, revocation and audit operate independently of Agent DPoP flow.
acceptance: Native web tests verify hashed session tokens, absent-origin/CSRF denial, idle expiration and session revocation.
mustNotOwn: Security Agent OAuth/DPoP verification or Agent admission policy
production IAM enrollment or deployment acceptance
formalObligations: A local test-only SQLite-backed session is not evidence of production reliability, or an argument to retain SQLite in long-term persistent architecture.

nodes.label: AgentGrantIssueAndRevocation
nodes.responsibility: Manage Principal-owned delegated Agent Grants, scope, revocation and remaining-effect budgets without inventing OAuth/DPoP verifier or Security policy.
nodes.authority: Web product/session/effect state only; Security/provider cryptographic and policy truth remain external
inputs: WebAuthn-authenticated Principal authorization and grant request
Agent identity, audience, actions, risk and resource scope
outputs: versioned Grant record; revocation and remaining-quota state with consumer-visible standing
nodes.behavioralContract: Issued Grants and revocations bind one Principal/Agent/scope and remain source-owned; revoked Grants block future effects without invalidating already committed historical exact replay.
acceptance: Owner Agent authority tests cover Grant revocation and future-effect denial distinct from historical committed receipts.
mustNotOwn: Security Agent OAuth/DPoP verification or Agent admission policy
production IAM enrollment or deployment acceptance
formalObligations: No generalization from canary Grant scope to live provider IAM or production issuance recovery.

nodes.label: DelegatedAgentEffectAdmissionAndReplay
nodes.responsibility: Authorize a specific delegated Agent effect by composing Security-owned request verification/admission with an exact Web Grant, effect identity and optional WebAuthn step-up, then preserve exact replay.
nodes.authority: Web product/session/effect state only; Security/provider cryptographic and policy truth remain external
inputs: verified OAuth/DPoP Agent request; Grant snapshot; proposed effect ID and payload
Security Agent Admission and Effect Admission decision; optional Principal WebAuthn approval
outputs: committed scoped effect receipt, stable exact replay, or denial/conflict
nodes.behavioralContract: No verifier implies fail-closed; ambiguous Grants and conflicting replay are rejected; exact replay of an already committed effect remains valid after Grant revocation, while fresh effects are denied; effect-bound STEP_UP consumes one permitted approval.
acceptance: Owner test suite checks exact replay and conflicting payload refusal, ambiguous Grants, missing Security verification, step-up and revocation.
mustNotOwn: Security Agent OAuth/DPoP verification or Agent admission policy
production IAM enrollment or deployment acceptance
formalObligations: Security external verifier/policy behavior must retain own source/installed bindings; canary evidence is not proof of real provider effect or production eligibility.

edges.label: principal and session source identity bounds browser mutations
Principal WebAuthn ceremony bounds grant issue/revocation
versioned Grant authorization restricts delegated Agent effect
WebAuthn step-up approval can bind a particular high-risk effect

knownGaps: Actual canary state uses SQLite; this planning record does not promote it to a permanent database or attest PG cutover.
Security-owned OAuth/DPoP and admission contract are imported via Web adapters; installed verifier and real user/provider authorization remain independently qualified.
App is explicitly non-production-eligible; E2E virtual CTAP2 is not physical-human-presence evidence.
